premises.text: Billions of connected things are coming into use
premises.evidence_span: 6 billion connected things will be in use till the end of this year

premises.text: People manage their digital life across dozens of apps and check their phones constantly
premises.evidence_span: I personally use more than 50 different apps to manage my digital life

premises.text: Users need a nicer way to communicate with technology than checking the phone every minute
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute

premises.text: Glance Clock is a wall clock with a glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform
premises.evidence_span: Glance Clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: Information appears as background geometric shapes rather than text and numbers
premises.evidence_span: The information appears in the background in geometric shapes rather than text and numbers

premises.text: An open-API cloud platform integrates with the user's favorite apps
premises.evidence_span: we have a cloud platform with a lot of integrations that can actually integrate via open APIs

premises.text: Glance Cloud analyzes the data to understand what information, when, and where to display
premises.evidence_span: Glance Cloud will analyze this data and understand what information, when, and where to display

premises.text: The clock works out of the box: pair a phone and it sets the current time automatically
premises.evidence_span: Our clocks ready out of the box and you just need to pair your phone with the clock and it will set up current time automatically

premises.text: Go-to-market runs through an Indiegogo crowdfunding campaign at a $149 price point
premises.evidence_span: we will launch Indiegogo campaign on February this year. And the estimated price will be just $149 for a single device

value.text: Relevant information from wearables, devices, and services arrives right at the moment it is needed
value.evidence_span: It shows you information from your wearables, connected devices, and web services right at the moment you need it

secondary_value.text: Information is readable at a glance without disrupting current tasks
secondary_value.evidence_span: It allows you to read information quickly at a glance without being disrupted from your current tasks
